milestone: M3 WAL/redo crash recovery and transactions
record_type: Continuation summary, not a verbatim conversation transcript
language_rationale: Keep the working Go engine; the standard library supplies TCP, JSON and filesystem support, and a CGO-disabled build produces a standalone binary for a small scratch Docker image.

protocol.now: MySQL protocol 10 handshake, COM_QUERY text results, OK/ERR/EOF, COM_PING, COM_INIT_DB, COM_QUIT; default :3306
protocol.auth: Advertise mysql_native_password; ignore response bytes and client plugin name; any username and empty/arbitrary password accepted. No credential verification or TLS.
protocol.wire_vs_line: Removed legacy line/JSON and server -query; host scripts/mysqlsmoke uses real go-sql-driver/mysql.
protocol.metadata: VARCHAR text columns; vectors JSON; legacy EOF; autocommit status; single database namespace
protocol.limits: 64 MiB incoming messages; no TLS, compression, multi-statements or server prepared statements

persistence.method: One newline-delimited JSON committed transaction record containing sequential LSN and successful deterministic write statements; append and fsync before publish/acknowledge. Autocommit uses one statement. WAL creation and recovery truncation are synced; directory is synced on Open.
persistence.recovery: Load optional legacy snapshot, replay contiguous complete WAL records. Truncate incomplete tail before accepting writes. Reject malformed complete records and sequence gaps. No new full snapshots; no checkpoint/compaction yet.
persistence.failure: Write/sync error blocks further durable writes until restart. Interrupted/unacknowledged commit can have uncertain outcome. One Engine/server per directory; no process lock.

smoke.observed_output: PASS: build, MySQL wire (go-sql-driver/mysql), empty/any-password auth, ERR, vector ranking, SIGKILL snapshot + WAL recovery, COMMIT/ROLLBACK/disconnect isolation, recovered vector ranking, DELETE/DROP

validation.engine_tests: WAL-only and snapshot-base recovery; rollback and active uncommitted exclusion; dirty-read isolation; conflict; read-only LSN; torn tail + subsequent append and repeated recovery; corruption/LSN rejection; DELETE/DROP. Multi-statement commit atomicity at truncated record boundaries; failed-statement exclusion and read-your-writes.

open_items: Atomic checkpoints and WAL compaction; unbounded WAL growth/replay and full-state cloning cost.
Checksums, process locking, and disk-failure/power-loss fault injection. Single server owner per directory required.
Official mysqltest pack and full contest SQL dialect unknown; no official tests/submission.
MySQL CLI unavailable; driver smoke used. Docker image built but container runtime not tested or image pushed.
Prepared statements, TLS and full MySQL session/status semantics unimplemented.
engine_changes_in_continuation: Replaced snapshot-per-commit persistence with fsynced logical redo WAL; maintained private transaction states and conflict checks; added recovery/rollback tests.
questions_and_decisions: Keep Engine/Session API and MySQL wire default :3306.
Use committed transaction records rather than logging BEGIN/abort; uncommitted state stays in memory.
Retain immutable legacy snapshot as base; defer compaction to avoid checkpoint/WAL ordering hazards.
Use repeated -query flags instead of SQL splitting to preserve strings and pin one connection.
Local verification only; no official submission, PR merge, secrets or build artifacts in git.

transactions.semantics: BEGIN or START TRANSACTION clones committed state; read-your-writes; no dirty reads. COMMIT checks database-wide version and logs successful statements atomically. ROLLBACK/disconnect discard private state. No in-flight transaction enters WAL. Failed statements leave preceding successful statements intact. Conflicts require ROLLBACK.
transactions.client: Repeat -query flags on scripts/mysqlsmoke; pinned database/sql connection; one SQL statement per flag; Exec for writes, JSON array per SELECT; stop on error.
